sources.topic: Dynamic program selection, current-task execution, entry index, KAREL start behavior and pause entry

contract.targets: Explicitly attached cooperative KAREL Program objects; projects use cooperative generation
contract.frames: Independent cursors/stacks over shared module globals and imported references; target registered tasks/generators retained
contract.scope: Calling-root budget, lifecycle, observations, parameters, default groups and ownership; nested program inspection and traces
contract.lines: All nonnegative KAREL line hints start at the beginning; no TP execution
contract.cache: Exact writable INTEGER, initialized after target validation; stable context-local hints, not saved
contract.control: Entry/body pauses retain nested cursors; root stop/abort/error unwinds frames and terminal resources
contract.persistence: Global values only; attach source again; no executable links, suspended frames or cache IDs

boundaries: No compiled PC/TP execution, native stack ABI, motion or implicit discovery
